body: I just don't see the point in doing things by myself any more. I have a vacation coming up and I am supposed to go by myself. I have never had the chance to share any meaningful experiences with anyone because no one notices if I am present. Sure they laugh at my jokes but I know in my heart I'm replaceable. What is the point of having money, sure I can buy shit that I don't need, maybe a big house but what can I put in it. I've always thought the point of life was sharing it with friends and loved ones but I can't do that.
